gloss: to run out, to be exhausted

definitions.gloss: to run out, to be exhausted, to be used up
definitions.explanation: For a supply, resource, or abstract quality to be completely depleted or exhausted. Describes reaching the end of something finite.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{尽|つ}きた。
⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{尽|つ}きて⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: We're in trouble because the food supply has run out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{尽|つ}きること⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{語|かた}り{合|あ}った→語り合う：03045_katariau⟧。
examples.english: Without running out of topics, we talked until morning.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Often used in the pattern X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{尽|つ}きる (X runs out). The negative form {尽|つ}きない and the pattern {尽|つ}きること⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without running out) are common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{尽|つ}きる — stamina runs out
- ⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{尽|つ}きる — food supply runs out
- ⟦{忍耐|にんたい}→忍耐：05212_nintai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{尽|つ}きる — patience runs out
- ⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{尽|つ}きない — topics never run out
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{尽|つ}きない — beyond words, inexpressible

SIMILAR WORDS:
なくなる is the everyday word for running out or disappearing. {尽|つ}きる is more literary and emphasizes complete exhaustion. ⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧ can also mean to run out (e.g., ⟦バッテリー→バッテリー：04425_batterii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧) but focuses on breaking or disconnecting.
